csv_project_name: Architectural Design Service for Domestic Violence Shelter
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Irving is soliciting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified architectural firms to provide professional architectural and related services for the evaluation, planning, and potential design of a Non-Congregate Domestic Violence Shelter. The selected firm will initially perform a feasibility study (Phase 1) to determine the most appropriate approach to meet the City s service needs, including evaluation of renovation versus new construction options. Based on the outcome of Phase 1, the City anticipates negotiating a contract amendment for full architectural and engineering design services.
